grade_rationale: 3 P1 findings exceed Grade C threshold (max_p1: 2). Two CVSS 9.8 RCE CVEs in active infrastructure + 1 active test-failing missing endpoint.

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection — multiple CVEs (max CVSS 9.8)
escalations.impact: Arbitrary JavaScript execution during template compilation
escalations.guardians_task: Verify no production code path invokes template compilation on user-controlled input

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8) — orchestrator + portal/Backend
escalations.vector: platform/orchestrator via dockerode→gRPC; portal/Backend via @opentelemetry transitive
escalations.impact: Remote code execution on orchestrator (controls all agent pipelines) and portal/Backend
escalations.fix_cmd:
cd platform/orchestrator && npm audit fix --force  # SOLO-SESSION ONLY — test all agent pipelines after
cd portal/Backend && npm audit fix
escalations.guardians_task: Assess attack surface — can external actors send arbitrary protobuf messages to orchestrator or portal endpoints?

escalations.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS via multiple route parameters (CVSS 7.5)
escalations.impact: CPU exhaustion via malformed URL with many route parameters — zero precondition, any network user
escalations.fix_cmd:
cd platform/orchestrator && npm update express path-to-regexp
cd portal/Backend && npm audit fix
escalations.guardians_task: Confirm orchestrator and portal/Backend are not directly internet-facing without rate limiting

escalations.title: PostCSS XSS via unescaped </style> in stringify output (CVSS 6.1)
escalations.vector: build chain; exploitable if user-controlled content processed as CSS
escalations.impact: XSS in rendered HTML if user CSS input processed via PostCSS
escalations.fix_cmd:
cd portal/Frontend && npm update postcss
cd Source/Frontend && npm update postcss
escalations.guardians_task: Determine if any user input flows through PostCSS processing in portal or Source/Frontend

p1.title: GET /api/search not mounted — 5 tests actively failing
p1.description: Route handler never mounted. searchRouter must be created (Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts) and wired in app.ts. 5 tests in tests/routes/search.test.ts fail on every npm test.
p1.recommendation: Create search.ts route with GET /api/search?q= doing fuzzy match on workItemStore. Mount with app.use('/api', searchRouter).

p2.title: Traceability enforcer blind to 88% of spec surface
p2.description: Enforcer only validates Plans/*/requirements.md → Source/ + E2E/. Leaves portal/ (1073 Verifies: comments), platform/ (FR-TMP-*), and Specifications/ (80+ FRs) completely unvalidated. Also non-deterministic when multiple requirements.md share same mtime.
p2.recommendation: Extend enforcer to accept multi-dir config. Add alphabetical mtime tiebreaking. Add inspector.config.yml spec→code pairs. Solo session or tooling owner.

p2.title: FR-TMP Verifies: comments stripped after docker→platform rename
p2.description: All 10 FR-TMP-* Verifies: comments lost during docker/→platform/ rename. grep -c 'FR-TMP' returns 0. Implementation (riskLevel, _runPlaywrightE2E, _createPR, _aiReviewPR, _autoMerge) is present but unlinked to spec.
p2.recommendation: Restore // Verifies: FR-TMP-XXX comments per the traceability-report-run3.md FR matrix. SOLO-SESSION ONLY — platform/ is off-limits to pipeline agents.

p2.title: blocked_by missing from portal UpdateBugInput and UpdateFeatureRequestInput
p2.description: UpdateFeatureRequestInput and UpdateBugInput both lack blocked_by?: string[]. DependencyPicker uses 'as any' cast as workaround — type safety hole.
p2.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both interfaces. Remove 'as any' casts from portal/Frontend/src/components/shared/DependencyPicker.tsx.

p2.title: portal/Backend seed.ts missing — dependency seeding absent
p2.description: No seed.ts exists. Required to create 8 known dependency relationships idempotently. Without it, dependency UI shows empty and E2E smoke tests cannot validate the full flow.
p2.recommendation: Create seed.ts with idempotent seedDependencies() for 8 known relationships. Wire into portal/Backend/src/index.ts startup after base data seeding.

p2.title: Two portal frontend test files missing
p2.description: Both test files never created. DependencySection.tsx (226 lines) and BlockedBadge.tsx (both amber + red states) have zero test coverage.
p2.recommendation: Create both test files. Each must carry // Verifies: FR-dependency-section and // Verifies: FR-dependency-blocked-badge comments respectively.

p2.title: Vite path traversal in optimized deps .map handling
p2.fix_cmd:
# Update vite to >=6.5.0 in each module
cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite
cd portal/Backend && npm update vite
cd portal/Frontend && npm update vite
p2.note: Major version bump — verify React + Vitest compatibility after upgrade

p2.title: OpenTelemetry SDK 4+ major versions behind (0.47.0 vs 0.216.0)
p2.description: 169-minor-version gap. Missing security patches and bug fixes in tracing infrastructure. Dedicated upgrade task required due to breaking API changes.
p2.recommendation: Create separate sprint: audit breaking changes 0.47 → 0.74, update tracing implementation, test with OTEL collector.

p3.title: Source/Frontend BlockedBadge missing amber pending_dependencies state
Silent .catch(()=>({})) in API client — violates architecture error-handling rule
esbuild CORS bypass in dev server (CVSS 5.3)
p3.fix_cmd: Update vite (bundles esbuild) to latest in all three modules

p3.title: Vitest/Vite-Node dependency chain issues in portal modules
p3.fix_cmd: cd portal/Backend && npm install vitest@4.1.5+; cd portal/Frontend && npm install vitest@4.1.5+

p3.title: Backend prod deps outdated (express@4, pino@8, uuid@9)

p4.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — workItemStore CRUD in routes
